description: Stores a restaurant request in a private moderation inbox after explicit user confirmation. Requires restaurant name, a short message, and a stable requestId; optionally a coarse town or city. Never provide precise location, private contact details or diary content. Never creates restaurants or imports menu data, and makes no promise of addition or a reply. Uses one shared assistant allowance attempt; submissions also share a stricter 3 per rolling 24 hours limit per account across web, mobile and assistants. Reuse requestId after uncertain outcomes.
name: request_restaurant
title: Request a restaurant for Enshape review
